Alex Chen: Rolling deploy scheduled: inference-runtime v2.8 -> prod
Time: 2026-03-18 23:00 UTC (approx)
Canaries: 10% for 15m, then 50% for 30m
Expect: negligible schema changes, no DB migration
Checklist below — please ack + fill availability

Priya Kapoor: I'm on call, can own canary monitoring. will watch latency/error dashboards :eyes:

Jamie O'Neill: I'll do the actual trigger and rollback if needed. Ping me 10m before.

Rachel Kim: Confirmed no DB migrations. Verified config diff: model weights pinned.

Alex Chen: Readback: canary policy = 10%->15m, 50%->30m, full if steady. Rollback condition: 3xx/4xx spikes? we use >2% error increase OR p50 latency +100ms sustained 5m

Priya Kapoor: Add health check: /health/inference returns 200 and kv cache hit >80% on warmup.

Jamie O'Neill: Trigger command I'll run:
```bash
deplyctl rollout start --service inference-runtime --version v2.8 --canary 10%
```
I will follow with:
```bash
deplyctl rollout promote --until 50%
``` 

Alex Chen: Pre-deploy smoke steps (ops):
- [ ] Verify staging smoke passed (qa)
- [ ] Load test golden path (5k reqs) :ram:
- [ ] Confirm autoscale policies intact
- [ ] Canary dashboards created
- [ ] Alerting runbooks pointed to oncall

deploy-bot: preflight results: staging-smoke=PASS, infra-checks=PASS, certs=OK

Priya Kapoor: I ran quick smoke on staging earlier, logs look clean. upload snippet: `curl -sS staging/api/health | jq .status -> OK`

Rachel Kim: Added rollback note: if KV cache cold-start errors >5% during 15m canary -> immediate rollback.

Alex Chen: Ops owners: @Priya (monitor), @Jamie (doer), @Rachel (config/rollback), @Alex (coord). Please confirm availability window 22:50-00:30 UTC

Priya Kapoor: Available 22:45-00:30

Jamie O'Neill: Available 22:50-23:30, but can extend if needed

Rachel Kim: I'll be on slack until 01:00 UTC

Alex Chen: Final go/no-go check — reply with 'go' or 'no-go' and note any blockers

Priya Kapoor: go :thumbsup:

Jamie O'Neill: go — will ping 10m prior

Rachel Kim: go

Alex Chen: Thanks. I'll post the start 10m before and run the deploy. Keeping runbook open: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/inference-deploy
